Assert a frozen release is structurally complete

Source: R/cloud.R
check_release_complete.Rd

Passing the consumer-contract suite says the data is right. It says nothing about whether the release is readable, and those are different questions — test_release.qmd asked only the first until 2026-08-14, when it passed 28/28 against genuinely-good parquet and promoted latest.txt to a release with no catalog.json. That is the file cc_get_db() opens, so every consumer resolving through latest got a 404 while the tests were green.

Usage

check_release_complete(
  version,
  bucket = "calcofi-db",
  required = RELEASE_REQUIRED_OBJECTS,
  halt = TRUE,
  prefix = "ducklake/releases"
)

Arguments

version

release version (e.g. "v2026.08.14")

bucket

GCS bucket holding {prefix}/

required

object names that must exist directly under the release

halt

logical; stop() when something is missing (default TRUE)

prefix

bucket-relative releases prefix (default ducklake/releases)

Value

invisibly, a data.frame with object and exists

Details

The cause was ordering: upload_frozen pushes parquet first and the JSON sidecars after, and the render died in between. The parquet was complete and valid, which is precisely why the tests passed.
